description: This bar chart illustrates quality scores for “IFD”, “TagNum”, and “DEITA” across different averaging methods. The horizontal axis, labeled “TagNum Quality Scores”, lists the categories “IFD”, “TagNum”, and “DEITA” in that order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Scores”, represents values on a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70 with tick labels at intervals of 5.  Each category has two bars representing scores: a lighter orange bar labeled “AvgSub” and a darker blue bar labeled “Base AvgGlob”. The bar for “IFD” shows an “AvgSub” score of approximately 41.90 and a “Base AvgGlob” score of approximately 39.13. For “TagNum”, the “AvgSub” score is approximately 42.99 and the “Base AvgGlob” score is about 66.06.  Lastly, “DEITA” has an "AvgSub" score of approximately 37.91 and a “Base AvgGlob” score of approximately 67.64. The scores are represented by the length of the bars. A dashed horizontal line at 63.98, labeled “Base AvgGlob”, spans the chart, and a dashed horizontal line at 64.71, also labeled "Base AvgGlob", is shown but only extends to the "DEITA" portion. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlining.
